```{r}
#| label: fig-inhospdeathcause
#| fig-cap: "Cause in-hospital death vs bilirubin"

plotdata <- escdata %>%
  filter(!is.na(death)) %>%
  group_by(Bili_mgdL_cat) %>%
  count(death) %>%
  mutate(
    p = n / sum(n) * 100,
    pprint = fn(p, 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

p <- ggplot(plotdata, aes(y = p, x = death, fill = Bili_mgdL_cat)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = global_cols[c(3, 4)]) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      color = "lightgrey",
      linewidth = 0.5,
      linetype = 2
    ),
    text = element_text(size = 19, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  labs(y = "In-hospital death (%)", fill = "Elevated bilirubin") +
  scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(n.dodge = 2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = pprint), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = -0.25, size = 5.5, fontface = "bold")

if (output) {
  create_pptx(p)
}
p
```
